Nine steps in time order: launch → data load → compute → NVLink → rail RDMA → optimizer → checkpoint → telemetry → OOB
⑤ GPU n HBM → PCIe → CX7 n → Leaf n → CX7 n → GPU n HBM · GPUDirect RDMA · both ways
⑤ GPU n HBM → PCIe → CX7 n → Leaf n → CX7 n → GPU n HBM · GPUDirect RDMA · both ways
